title: Force-Induced Phase Transitions in Self-Attracting Polymers
statement: For the force-extended partially directed self-attracting polymer model on $\mathbb{Z}^2$, whose generating function $H(x,y,z)$ records contacts, span in the force direction, and length, determine the order of its force-induced compact-to-expanded phase transition.
